answer_1.quote: In the first stage, we employ a T5-based passage generation model to map an input query to the passage content ... In the second stage, another T5-based PLM is employed to predict the corresponding URL as the retrieval result, utilizing the passage generated by the passage generation model as input.

answer_2.quote: We adopt Hits@1 as the evaluation metric. ... We also use perplexity (PPL) to estimate the model capacity and monitor how perplexity changes as training steps increase.
